candidates.change_summary: Changed the withdraw target from Owner to msg.sender so funds are sent to the caller instead of the stored Owner.
Removed the require check, allowing anyone to call withdraw and transfer the contract balance to Owner.
Reordered statements: transfer is attempted before the require check, so transfer executes regardless of require (which would revert after transfer if failing).
Changed transfer to send, which returns a boolean instead of reverting on failure, altering observed behavior when transfer would fail.
Replaced transfer with low-level call to send funds, forwarding all gas and returning success; behavior differs on failure handling.
Added zeroing of Owner before transfer so funds are sent to the zero address, changing post-call Owner reading (withdraw outcome as balance moved to address(0)).
